# Justin Jackson (xfnl.studio)
> Program Manager, Marketing Operations & AI Systems at Commerce (parent brand of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift). Former Creative Operations & Publishing Specialist at Apple (Apple TV+ & Apple Music) and Commercial Video Producer for CreatorIQ.

## Core Outcomes
- 2.9x deliverable throughput lift across 50 marketers at Commerce (419 to 1,213 per quarter).
- +81% output lift per active contributor (22.1 to 40.1 deliverables/quarter) with flat headcount.
- 0% to 39% brief compliance in 30 days via Family Sync (Claude Code + Asana v3 Node.js SDK).
- 3-day Gartner Magic Quadrant launch turnaround and on-time April 2026 BigCommerce Payments launch (thanked by name by CEO Travis Hess).
- Solo-architected a 3-Body, 4-accelerator local AI operating system (GroupThink, APPA 24fps NLE compiler, Clarity voice partner) across 64 GB pooled VRAM/unified memory.
